# Release Notes

## 0.40.3 — 2026-10-18

- **ARTIFACT DEPLOYED; MANUAL REAL-CARD QA PENDING.** Partner registration now reserves `PartnerTrialClaim` without creating a subscription; finance access through PWA/API/bot requires a confirmed card across family, manual and paid paths. A valid PSP bind callback activates the exact snapshotted trial days, including `90` and `7889`; `auto_renew=false` and `next_charge=None`. Replay/rebind protection, entitlement preservation and reserved cardless legacy claims are retained. Runtime exact SHA `253c276b097b12ac29dc77d02f58cd6a5c2985df` was deployed from implementation PR `#46` (`4aae2b594b765808252c04e9da6ceeba9f385162`) after validation `39152126820`, exact-main validation `39152591339` and manually approved production run `39153085298`. Deployment evidence artifact `12146235695` completed at `2026-10-18T18:16:28.861297+00:00`; external `/app/`, `/healthz` and `/readyz` returned HTTP `200`. The timestamp is evidence completion, not a separately observed atomic activation time. Canonical CI passed bot, Django, isolated PWA and image tests. Owner manual real-card QA remains pending; the local synthetic browser harness crashed during tiny-headless-shell screenshot capture, so no browser card flow is claimed passed. See `code/docs/releases/0.40.3-partner-card-required.md`.
- Documentation-only post-deploy synchronization; no runtime redeploy.
